Let's keep putting in the effort to win!

Mm! Results ride on one's determination!
And my determination will lose to no one!

text_block_list.text: Come up with a training menu that can whip all the Umamusume into shape in one fell swoop!

text_block_list.text:
As expected of my Tactician, nothing escapes you!
One cannot easily claim that effort always bears fruit,
but without effort, there is nothing to speak of!

text_block_list.text: First, let us begin with a strategy meeting! Tonight, we hold a war council until dawn!
